embedding_signature.instruction: Retrieve database schemas, field definitions and query examples needed to answer the database question.

reranker_signature.instruction: Given a database question, judge whether the document provides evidence needed to answer it. Consider the business domain, requested entities, attributes, filters, grouping and aggregation. Shared identifiers alone do not establish relevance.

limitations: Table-to-knowledge proxy benchmark, not question retrieval or SQL generation accuracy.
Fixed Top-K hypotheses are not confirmed preprocessing associations.
Development evaluation on an existing reviewed set, not held-out generalization.
For the new corpus only identical ID AND text is judged; changed/new text is unjudged.
New-corpus precision/F1 uses judged predictions only; inspect judged_fraction and unjudged counts.
Schema embedding is truncated at 512 tokens; reranking pairs are truncated at 2048 tokens.
